items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember a gig that I did with her... I know that was one of the gigs that I did with Astrid.

ctx.x: Then we get into ’67, Astrid Gilberto.

Yeah, that’s – yeah, I enjoyed those gigs. I remember a gig that I did with her. It was right there on top of that RCA building, across the street from where the Rockettes – she had a gig there. And I think we did – I don’t remember everything that I did with her, but I know that was one of the gigs that I did with Astrid. I think I may have recorded with her as well, but I’m not sure.
Yeah. That’s what this is showing, on Verve.
